points.problem: Lighthouse CI audited only home desktop, leaving mobile regressions ungated.
points.implementation: PR #671 preserves desktop gate and adds 390x844 mobile Lighthouse assertions. First mobile run exposed LCP 5569.962ms versus <=5000ms. Follow-up commit 58b6c88 changed mobile collection from one run to three runs so LHCI evaluates a median instead of a single noisy sample; thresholds were not relaxed.
points.evidence: Commit 58b6c88 CI completed: frontend SUCCESS; Lighthouse desktop SUCCESS; Lighthouse mobile FAILURE after 3-run collection.
points.next: Keep gate red. Obtain exact mobile LCP evidence before layout changes; do not relax <=5000ms.

points.problem: Runtime had no repeatable production smoke for broken critical JS/CSS assets.
points.implementation: Added npm smoke:runtime. It fetches production home with cache bypass, requires #root, discovers same-origin JS/CSS, probes each critical asset, and reports release-sha when available.
points.evidence: Executed directly from VPS against https://cutinapp.petertecnet.com.br/: HTTP/runtime smoke OK; release e744659b44d514df0fdf7f67431320c044cc9da1; 2 critical assets checked with no failures. Source published to main through commits f5c9aa5d, 113d912f and corrective baseline-preservation commit 8ab674b3.
points.next: Integrate smoke into release verification once deploy transport is healthy; expand representative routes without duplicating route-owner tests.

points.problem: Production is demonstrably stale relative to current main, and local nginx 443 probe is unavailable on the VPS while public HTTPS still serves the older release.
points.evidence: VPS measurement: origin/main before W10 smoke work was a3706a8c509a0b0a2fa679e642785161a98aa09f; build/release-sha.txt=e744659b44d514df0fdf7f67431320c044cc9da1; public HTTPS release-sha=e744659b44d514df0fdf7f67431320c044cc9da1. curl --resolve cutinapp.petertecnet.com.br:443:127.0.0.1 failed because nothing listens on local 443, while SSH listens on :22.
